hook.say: Swimming cats, giant dogs and one of the world's rarest birds. Five questions on Turkey's wildlife!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which big guardian dog comes from Sivas Province?
questions.say: Which big guardian dog comes from See-vas Province?
questions.fact: Kangals have guarded flocks from wolves for centuries.
questions.sayAnswer: The Kangal! Kangals have guarded flocks from wolves for centuries.

questions.q: Which flower reached Europe from the Ottoman Empire in the 1500s?
questions.say: Which flower reached Europe from the Ottoman Empire in the 1500s?
questions.fact: The word tulip is thought to come from a word for turban.
questions.sayAnswer: The tulip! The word tulip is thought to come from a word for turban.

questions.q: Which Turkish cat is nicknamed the "swimming cat"?
questions.say: Which Turkish cat is nicknamed the swimming cat?
questions.fact: Van cats, from the Lake Van region, can have odd-coloured eyes.
questions.sayAnswer: The Van cat! Van cats, from the Lake Van region, can have odd-coloured eyes.

questions.q: İztuzu Beach near Dalyan is a protected nesting site for which animal?
questions.say: Iz-too-zoo Beach, near Dalyan, is a protected nesting site for which animal?
questions.fact: The beach has been protected since 1988.
questions.sayAnswer: Loggerhead turtles! The beach has been protected since 1988.

questions.q: Which very rare bird is protected at Birecik in Şanlıurfa?
questions.say: Which very rare bird is protected at Bee-reh-jik, in Shan-luh-oor-fa?
questions.fact: A breeding station has cared for Birecik's bald ibises since the 1970s.
questions.sayAnswer: The northern bald ibis! A breeding station has cared for the birds there since the 1970s.
